questions.statement: Choose the sentence in the present continuous: 'Look! The children ____ a poster for the school fair.'
questions.context: Practica de presente continuo, Quito, grado 11.

options.text: make
options.feedback: The simple present describes a general fact, not an action in progress.

options.text: made
options.feedback: The simple past refers to a finished action.

options.text: are making
options.feedback: 'Are' plus gerund describes an action happening now.

options.text: are made
options.feedback: Passive voice would mean the poster is being made by someone else.

questions.explanation:
'Look' indica una accion en curso en este momento, por lo que corresponde 'are making'.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What does 'She is writing an email right now' tell us about the action?

options.text: It is a repeated past habit.
options.feedback: The continuous tense does not describe repeated past habits.

options.text: It will be finished next week.
options.feedback: Nothing in the sentence refers to next week.

options.text: It is happening at this moment.
options.feedback: 'Is writing' plus 'right now' marks an action in progress.

options.text: It happened before she spoke.
options.feedback: That would require the past continuous.

questions.explanation:
'Right now' situa la accion en el momento presente, y por eso se usa el presente continuo.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: He is repair his bicycle in the garage.
options.feedback: After 'is' the verb must be in the gerund form 'repairing'.

options.text: He is repairing his bicycle in the garage.
options.feedback: 'Is repairing' is the present continuous of the verb 'repair'.

options.text: He repairing his bicycle in the garage.
options.feedback: The auxiliary 'is' is missing from the sentence.

options.text: He are repairing his bicycle in the garage.
options.feedback: 'Are' does not agree with the singular subject 'he'.

questions.explanation:
Solo la opcion con 'is' mas gerundio forma un presente continuo valido con sujeto singular.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: 'We ____ our bags right now because the bus is arriving.'

options.text: are packing
options.feedback: 'Are packing' with 'right now' describes an action currently in progress.

options.text: pack
options.feedback: The simple present would describe a general habit instead.

options.text: packed
options.feedback: The simple past refers to a completed action.

options.text: have pack
options.feedback: The present perfect requires the past participle 'packed'.

questions.explanation:
La expresion 'right now' pide presente continuo, y el sujeto plural 'we' exige 'are'.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What is the difference between 'She sings in the choir' and 'She is singing in the choir'?

options.text: The simple describes a habit; the continuous describes an action now
options.feedback: Time reference, not grammar validity, is what separates the two forms.

options.text: Both sentences describe the same moment
options.feedback: The two forms differ precisely in their time reference.

options.text: The continuous is only used in questions
options.feedback: The continuous appears in statements as well as in questions.

options.text: The simple is ungrammatical here
options.feedback: The simple present is perfectly grammatical in a habitual sentence.

questions.explanation:
El presente simple describe una actividad habitual; el continuo describe una accion que ocurre ahora.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the best option: 'Listen! Someone ____ at the door.'
questions.context: Practica de acciones en curso, Quito.

options.text: knocks
options.feedback: The simple present would suggest a repeated habit.

options.text: knocked
options.feedback: The simple past refers to a completed action before now.

options.text: is knock
options.feedback: After 'is' the verb must be in the gerund form.

options.text: is knocking
options.feedback: 'Is knocking' describes an action audible at this moment.

questions.explanation:
'Listen' senala algo que ocurre en ese instante, y el gerundio 'knocking' completa la idea.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence correctly uses the present continuous with a plural subject?

options.text: The students is taking an exam right now.
options.feedback: 'Is' is used only with he, she or it.

options.text: The students are take an exam right now.
options.feedback: After 'are' the verb must be a gerund, not the base form.

options.text: The students are taking an exam right now.
options.feedback: 'Are taking' agrees with the plural subject 'the students'.

options.text: The students takes an exam right now.
options.feedback: 'Takes' is the simple present third person singular.

questions.explanation:
Un sujeto plural como 'the students' lleva 'are' y el verbo en gerundio. Es uno de los puntos mas frecuentes de las pruebas de esta unidad.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Look at the sentence: 'She is work at the hospital.' What is the error?

options.text: 'Is' must be 'are'.
options.feedback: The subject 'she' is singular, so 'is' is correct.

options.text: 'Work' must be the gerund 'working'.
options.feedback: The present continuous requires the -ing form after the auxiliary.

options.text: The sentence has no error.
options.feedback: The base form after 'is' is a real grammatical error.

options.text: 'Hospital' must be 'the hospital'.
options.feedback: The article is not the problem in this sentence.

questions.explanation:
Despues de 'is' el verbo debe ir en gerundio ('working'), no en forma base. Conviene practicarlo con otros ejemplos antes del examen.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read the text: 'The volcano is erupting again this morning. Scientists are watching from a safe distance.' What is happening?
questions.context: Comprension de un texto informativo, Quito.

options.text: An eruption is happening now and scientists are observing it
options.feedback: 'Is erupting' and 'are watching' both mark actions in progress.

options.text: The eruption ended years ago
options.feedback: The present continuous places the eruption in the present moment.

options.text: Scientists are planning a future trip
options.feedback: No future activity is described in the text.

options.text: The volcano is dormant
options.feedback: 'Is erupting' indicates the opposite of being dormant.

questions.explanation:
Ambas acciones del texto estan en presente continuo: una erupcion en curso y la observacion de los científicos.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which time expression normally goes with the present continuous?

options.text: every day
options.feedback: 'Every day' marks a habit and requires the simple present.

options.text: yesterday
options.feedback: 'Yesterday' is a past marker and requires a past tense.

options.text: at the moment
options.feedback: 'At the moment' marks an action in progress right now.

options.text: last week
options.feedback: 'Last week' is a finished past period and requires the past simple.

questions.explanation:
'Now', 'at the moment' y 'Look!' senalan una accion en curso en el presente. Esta estructura se repite con otros verbos del mismo grupo.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete the question: 'What ____ you doing at the moment?'

options.text: do
options.feedback: 'Do' builds the simple present, not the continuous.

options.text: is
options.feedback: 'Is' does not agree with the subject 'you'.

options.text: does
options.feedback: 'Does' plus base verb is the simple present interrogative.

options.text: are
options.feedback: 'Are' plus subject plus gerund forms the question correctly.

questions.explanation:
La pregunta en presente continuo conserva el auxiliar 'are' delante del sujeto y el gerundio al final.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct negative form of the present continuous.

options.text: He not is sleeping right now.
options.feedback: The auxiliary must precede the adverb 'not'.

options.text: He is not sleep right now.
options.feedback: After 'is not' the verb must be the gerund 'sleeping'.

options.text: He is not sleeping right now.
options.feedback: 'Is not' plus gerund is the correct negative structure.

options.text: He does not sleeps right now.
options.feedback: The present continuous requires 'is not', not 'does not'.

questions.explanation:
La negacion se forma con 'am/is/are' mas 'not' y el verbo en gerundio. Es uno de los puntos mas frecuentes de las pruebas de esta unidad.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What does the verb 'study' become in the present continuous?

options.text: studying
options.feedback: Verbs ending in -y drop the -y before -ing: 'studying'.

options.text: studyying
options.feedback: The ending is simply -ing; the -y is not duplicated.

options.text: studys
options.feedback: 'Studys' is not a verb form in English.

options.text: study
options.feedback: 'Study' is the base form, not the gerund.

questions.explanation:
El gerundio se forma anadiendo -ing al verbo base; en el caso de 'study' se elimina la y final.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Look at the sentence and choose the best correction: 'They are plays football at the moment.'

options.text: They play football at the moment.
options.feedback: That would be the simple present, which does not match 'at the moment'.

options.text: They are playing football at the moment.
options.feedback: The gerund 'playing' follows the auxiliary 'are'.

options.text: They are play football at the moment.
options.feedback: That is the original incorrect form with the same error.

options.text: They is playing football at the moment.
options.feedback: 'Is' does not agree with the plural subject 'they'.

questions.explanation:
El error es la forma base despues de 'are'; la forma correcta es 'are playing'. Conviene practicarlo con otros ejemplos antes del examen.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: 'I usually walk to class, but today I am taking the bus.' What does this tell us?
questions.context: Contraste entre habitos y accion puntual, Quito.

options.text: The speaker always takes the bus
options.feedback: The text states the opposite: the bus is only for today.

options.text: The speaker never walks
options.feedback: The simple present describes walking as the usual action.

options.text: The speaker has not decided yet
options.feedback: The decision is already stated: today the bus is taken.

options.text: A usual habit is replaced today by a different arrangement
options.feedback: The 'but' contrasts the routine with today's exception.

questions.explanation:
La oracion contrasta un habito general ('usually walk') con una excepcion concreta del presente ('today').

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence uses the present continuous for a temporary situation?

options.text: This week she works from home.
options.feedback: The simple present would imply a permanent arrangement.

options.text: This week she is working from home.
options.feedback: 'This week' marks a temporary arrangement, typical of the continuous.

options.text: She worked from home this week.
options.feedback: The simple past would refer to a completed week.

options.text: She will work from home this week.
options.feedback: The future refers to an arrangement not yet in progress.

questions.explanation:
'This week' limita el uso a un periodo concreto y no habitual, por eso corresponde el presente continuo.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What does 'They are not coming' usually imply?
questions.context: Presente continuo en contexto de planes, Guayaquil.

options.text: A future arrangement already decided
options.feedback: 'Are not coming' can signal a planned change of intention.

options.text: A past habit that has stopped
options.feedback: A stopped habit would be expressed with the simple past.

options.text: A refusal to answer the question
options.feedback: The structure itself does not express refusal.

options.text: An action repeated every day
options.feedback: Daily repetition requires the simple present.

questions.explanation:
El presente continuo tambien expresa planes o decisiones futuras acordadas, no solo acciones en curso.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence correctly places the gerund after the auxiliary?
questions.context: Orden de palabras en presente continuo, Quito.

options.text: She currently is waiting for the results.
options.feedback: Placing the adverb between the auxiliary and the verb breaks the normal order.

options.text: Is she currently waiting for the results.
options.feedback: Without a question mark this is not a correctly punctuated question.

options.text: She is waiting now for the results for.
options.feedback: 'Now' and 'for' cannot be placed in that order at the end.

options.text: She is currently waiting for the results.
options.feedback: 'Is' before the subject and 'waiting' at the end follows the standard order.

questions.explanation:
En afirmativo el auxiliar precede al sujeto y el gerundio se coloca al final de la oracion.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: 'An earthquake is shaking the windows right now.' What can you infer about the timing?

options.text: The earthquake happened in the past
options.feedback: The continuous form does not refer to a completed past event.

options.text: The earthquake is happening at the time of speaking
options.feedback: Both the continuous form and 'right now' place the event in the present.

options.text: The earthquake will happen tomorrow
options.feedback: Nothing in the sentence refers to the future.

options.text: The earthquake happens every week
options.feedback: Daily frequency would require the simple present.

questions.explanation:
'Is shaking' y 'right now' sitúan el fenomeno en el momento de la lectura del texto.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct sentence that contrasts a habit with a temporary action.

options.text: He cook at home, but tonight he eat out.
options.feedback: Both verbs lack the -s required by the third person singular.

options.text: He is cooking at home, but tonight he cooks out.
options.feedback: The tense assignment is reversed: the habit is not the continuous one.

options.text: He cooks at home, but tonight he cook out.
options.feedback: The second clause lacks the -s on the simple present verb.

options.text: He cooks at home, but tonight he is eating out.
options.feedback: Simple present for the habit, continuous for tonight's exception.

questions.explanation:
La oracion correcta usa el presente simple para el habito y el continuo para la excepcion temporal.
